content: {"praised": ["Spiral Road is an excellent, thoughtful film with lush tropical visuals.", "Hudson portrays an ambitious doctor with confidence and depth.", "The film explores humanity and community themes poignantly.", "Hudson’s performance is highlighted as a standout.", "The story emphasizes the need for connection and faith."], "criticized": ["The collection is haphazard and not representative of Hudson’s best work.", "The Last Sunset had a freezing spot that ruined the viewing.", "A Very Special Favor is an inane sex comedy that turned viewers off.", "The set includes films that are not high points of Hudson’s career.", "Some reviewers returned the entire collection due to poor film quality."]}
